successors.name: United States of America
successors.text: all the Hawaiian Islands: 'The transfer of sovereignty over the Hawaiian islands took place on August 12, 1898'

ledger.x: 1894: the Republic of Hawai'i replaces the Provisional Government.
1898: the Republic is annexed by the United States.

wars.name: Wilcox rebellion of 1895 (royalist counter-revolution)
wars.outcome: A royalist attempt to capture the government buildings (infobox 6-9 January 1895); arms and ammunition landed from San Francisco and later found at Washington Place.

certainty.note: An island archipelago; the coast is the border.
